title: 5.11.4 Debugging: The pipes that never leave
description: Two planted bugs. Pipes vanish from the screen and the list grows for ever; then splicing skips every other pipe.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: Watch the list count in the console: it only goes up. Pipes are deleted but never spliced out of the array.

steps.title: Bug 1: delete without splice
steps.instructions: Add `pipes.splice(i, 1)` next to `delete()` in the same branch.

steps.title: Bug 2: the loop runs forwards
steps.instructions: A splice moves every later pipe down one place, so a forward loop skips the next one. Loop from the end: `for (let i = pipes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--)`.

requirements.title: Gone from the list too
requirements.description: An off-screen pipe is deleted and spliced in the same branch. Help: 5.11.1 (Reading: A world that scrolls)

requirements.title: The loop runs backwards
requirements.description: The sweep starts at the end of the array. Help: 5.11.1 (Reading: A world that scrolls)
